comment: The threshold knob is scaled so that its display reads volts directly, 25mV to 5V, and it starts at playing level rather than at zero. The attack and release knobs are square-law, so the short times are reachable. The repeats run on a pool of sixteen voices; a fast clock with a long release steals the voice nearest the end of its envelope, with a short fade to stop the click. Freeze latches, tilt is momentary, and both have a gate jack that does the same job. Only the left output sums; patching both keeps them separate. configBypass passes each input to the output on its side. The module is a from-scratch homage to the AC noises CONTINUA pedal, rebuilt from that pedal's public documentation rather than from a schematic. The panel prints perge, mix, tempo, pitch, sustain, glt/dim, lofi/crs, rvrb/smr, lp/hp, sens, thrs, atk, rel, mod, dcay, sprd, infx, tempo, pitch, sust, glit, filt, in l, in r, capt, clock, frz, tilt, mode, L and R.
